reviews.text: i'm a bit upset that i received it damaged, and i will have to contact customer service
reviews.zh: 我收到嘅貨品有損壞，覺得有啲唔開心，要聯絡客服。

reviews.text: The pigment is great and the color combo is also very nice. Easy to just use one palette for travelling
reviews.zh: 顯色度好好，顏色配搭亦都好靚。旅行帶一盒就夠用，好方便。

reviews.text: Absolutely loveee this palette. All the colors are so pretty and easy to use. The shimmery shadow is good for use as highlighter.
reviews.zh: 超級鍾意呢盒眼影盤。所有顏色都好靚又好用。帶閃嘅眼影用嚟做 highlight 都得。

reviews.text: Bought this palette after watching Single’s Inferno’s Siyeon’s makeup tutorial on YouTube! Excited to use it for the aegyo makeup.
reviews.zh: 睇完 YouTube 上 Single's Inferno 嘅 Siyeon 化妝教學之後就買咗呢盒眼影盤！好期待用佢化 aegyo 妝。

reviews.text:
So so so so beautiful! I love the formula of these eyeshadows, I originally bought neutral muse facets, and I loved it so much I decided to get another shade! 
Cool muse facets has such pretty pink and lilac shades, and I love the glitter and shimmer. 
The larger pink shade works well as a base but also a really cute blush!
If you want a high quality and versatile eyeshadow palette, I definitely recommend these palettes!
reviews.zh: 靚到爆！我好鍾意呢啲眼影嘅質地，本來買咗 neutral muse facets，鍾意到再買多一盒！Cool muse facets 有好靚嘅粉紅色同淡紫色調，我好鍾意佢嘅閃粉同光澤。比較大格嘅粉紅色用嚟做底色好 OK，仲可以做胭脂添！如果你想要一盒高質素又多用途嘅眼影盤，我一定推薦呢幾盒！

reviews.text:
Such a gorgeous palette! I’d put it more under neutral-cool, but I think these shades would suit anyone! I love dusty rose shades and this is the perfect palette for that ! The pigmentation is really good too, plus the shades blend really well. 
The shades aren’t chalky or too powdery, the texture is nice and velvety. 
I love the formula for this palette so much I went and ordered cook muse facets as well!
reviews.zh: 超靚嘅眼影盤！我會將佢歸類為中至冷調，但覺得呢啲色應該邊個都夾。我好鍾意玫瑰木色調，呢盒就啱晒！顯色度好好，顏色之間亦都好易推開。顏色唔會過份粉感或者太碎，質地好滑好有絲絨感。我太鍾意呢盒嘅配方，所以再訂咗 cook muse facets！

reviews.text: long lasting, usually my aegyo sal disappears when i use other palettes but w this it lasts, the darkest colour can be used for eyeliner too
reviews.zh: 持久度好好，平時用其他眼影盤 aegyo sal（臥蠶）好快就消失，但用呢盒就 keep 到，最深嗰隻色仲可以用嚟畫眼線。

reviews.text: I use this daily, i enjoy the pigment and the colors, easy to apply, however it doesnt last very long throughout the day
reviews.zh: 我日日都用，鍾意佢嘅顯色度同顏色，好易上色，不過就唔太撐得到全日。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
